module counter_12 
(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

reg [3:0] count;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  if (~rst_n) begin
    count <= 4'b0000;
  end else begin
    if (valid_count) begin
      count <= count + 1;
    end
  end
end

always @* begin
  if (count == 12) begin
    out = 4'b1111;
  end else begin
    out = count;
  end
end

endmodule

module traffic_light
    (
		input rst_n, 
        input clk, 
        input pass_request,
		output reg [7:0] clock,
        output reg red,
		output reg yellow,
		output reg green
    );
	
	parameter idle = 2'd0,
			  s1_red = 2'd1,
			  s2_yellow = 2'd2,
			  s3_green = 2'd3;
			  
	reg [1:0] state;
	
	always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
		if (~rst_n) begin
			state <= idle;
		end else begin
			case (state)
				idle: begin
					if (pass_request) begin

module traffic_light
    (
		input rst_n, 
        input clk, 
        input pass_request,
		output reg [7:0] clock,
        output reg red,
		output reg yellow,
		output reg green
    );
	
	parameter 	idle = 2'd0,
				s1_red = 2'd1,
				s2_yellow = 2'd2,
				s3_green = 2'd3;

	reg [1:0] state, next_state;
	
	always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
		if (~rst_n) begin
			state <= idle;
		end
		else begin
			state <= next_state;
		end
	end
	
	always @* begin
		next_state = state;
		case(state)
			idle: begin
				if (pass_request) begin
					next_state = s1_red;
				end
			end
			s1_red: begin
				next_state = s2_yellow;
			end
			s2_yellow: begin
				next_state = s3_green;
			end
			s3_green: begin
				next_state = idle;
			end
		endcase
	end
	
	always @(state) begin
		red = (state == s1_red);
		yellow = (state == s2_yellow);
		green = (state == s3_green);
	end
	
	always @(posedge clk) begin
		clock <= clock + 1;
	end

endmodule
